overview_description.description: Supadock builds AI workers that automate logistics operations in physical industries such as trucking, freight brokerage, and 3PL services. The company focuses on high-accountability workflows where calls, documents, and signatures are required to prove diligence and maintain compliance. Its AI agents use inputs such as cameras, voice, email, and document processing to execute operational tasks. Typical uses include verifying driver identities, coordinating warehouse entry, assigning shipments to carriers, checking freight status, and reconciling pickup and delivery paperwork. Supadock also automates proof-of-delivery checks, invoice audits, and follow-ups on late invoices to reduce liability and support risk management in logistics operations.
